args.body: Advance the existing SUPPLIER-BID-EFFORT-VERIFIED-RELEASE mission if open. Reuse equivalent committed evidence and read the public GET receipt before deciding. If the worksheet is already served, compare its bytes with the approved release evidence and confirm that its stated audience can reach the worksheet from the served page. If it is absent, reuse the current exact-digest and independence records. Attempt deployment only if the host gate permits this provider and the exact current digest is approved. Otherwise retain the existing independence blocker with the precise evidence that would reopen the release. Read back committed evidence and close under an actual valid lease when the mission criteria are met, with a lesson. Record availability separately from use, buyer interest and revenue.
